description: This Java class models the <menu> XML element within the OFBiz widget framework. It is an immutable, read-only data structure that represents menu configurations, including menu items, actions, styles, and inheritance from parent menus. It provides methods for rendering menus as strings and managing menu items.

classes.name: ModelMenu
